snippets.description: FORBIDDEN_FIELDS (model/models/plugins/provider/tools/max_tokens/temperature/response_format/messages...), x-aduin-client header, Origin must equal own origin + sec-fetch-site same-origin, content-type application/json only
readBodyCapped: content-length cap AND streamed byte cap (AI 128 KB, OCR 700 KB), fatal UTF-8 decode

shapeAi / shapeOcr whitelist shaping (ext + unknown fields dropped, settings checked for forbidden keys), application/pdf -> 415 before any port call, imageBase64: only raw base64 or data:image/(png|jpeg|webp);base64 (no http/file/other URL: no SSRF)
ipPrefix: cf-connecting-ip only (never x-forwarded-for), IPv6 truncated to /64; ipHash: daily-salted sha256

resolveVisitor: verifyCookie against the kid map (Phase 01 helper), mint {v,iat,exp,kid} otherwise; withTurnstilePass uses resign() (preserves claims); turnstileFresh rejects future t; __Host- cookie attributes
UTC-day keys; capFor; Claims with refundAll; claimAi (req on v, fresh-doc on v AND ip hash, then global) and claimOcr (pages on v and ip, then the SAME global provider counter)

handleProxy ordering: guards -> pre-limit -> config (fail closed) -> identity -> cache read (hit: no claim/write/upstream) -> uploads/key/breaker checks -> Turnstile (fail closed) -> claims (refund on refusal/port error) -> hold-open stream -> classify -> cache put -> ledger -> terminal frame; circuit breaker on non-zero cost or non-:free serving model while paid disabled

once(): 120 s timeout + client-abort via AbortController; callWithFallback: paid path only when PAID_FALLBACK_ENABLED exactly 'true', paid list non-empty, free result retryable, and the max-cost reservation fits under the spend cap

server-built body (model, models[], messages, temperature 0, max_tokens, strict json_schema); no plugins/tools/provider/file parts; OCR body by string template (no base64 re-serialize); Bearer key only in the authorization header
429/402/non-2xx/malformed/error-field mapped to codes+reasons; upstream bodies never echoed; one repair attempt; schema validation of content

free-only validation (:free suffix, openrouter/* rejected), exact-'true' paid flag, base URL https + host openrouter.ai (no port/creds/query), cookie kid must exist in the map, keys >= 32 bytes, spend cap <= $10
redactor: drops authorization/x-api-key/cookie/body/messages/data_b64/token..., scrubs secret values and Bearer tokens; logging never throws
siteverify through injected fetch; fail closed on missing secret/token, oversize token, network error, non-2xx, malformed body, success !== true
errorStatus(code) + shared ErrorDetail body; cache-control no-store on every proxy response; no CORS headers
